title.zh: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%
title.en: Datavault AI称未能从Biconomy提取比特币，股价暴跌近50%

current_state.zh: Datavault AI disclosed in an October 26 8-K that bitcoin held in its Biconomy account has not been withdrawable since a June request, sending its shares down nearly 50%; the coins originated from a $150M bitcoin-denominated share subscription by Scilex Holding in September 2025.
